quickstackcraft.tutorial.title: QuickStack & Craft Tutorial
quickstackcraft.tutorial.first_run_note: Pause, replay or drag the timeline. Open this guide anytime from Settings.
quickstackcraft.tutorial.quick_stack.cap: Nearby storage already holds matching cobblestone and planks.
Open your inventory and select Quick Stack Nearby.
Matching items move while unrelated and locked items stay put.
Gold outlines show which storage received items.
quickstackcraft.tutorial.restock.title: Restock Nearby
quickstackcraft.tutorial.restock.caption: Nearby storage holds more of the partial stacks in your inventory.
Select R in your inventory or bind Restock Partial Stacks in Controls.
Existing unlocked stacks fill up; empty and locked slots remain unchanged.
Cyan outlines show which storage supplied the items.
quickstackcraft.tutorial.craft_nearby.ca: The nearby chest contains three iron ingots and two sticks.
Your inventory is empty, but nearby materials still count.
Open the crafting table and select the iron pickaxe in the recipe book.
Ingredients move safely from nearby storage into the crafting grid.
The same nearby transfer works with JEI and EMI when installed.
quickstackcraft.tutorial.dump_locks.capt: Alt-click a slot to protect an item with a native lock.
Dump Unlocked Items moves everything else into nearby storage.
Locked items remain in place while destination storage is outlined.
quickstackcraft.tutorial.storage_preview: Preview Nearby Storage is a separate hotkey. Bind it in Options > Controls > QuickStack & Craft.
Press that hotkey in the world to outline every eligible storage location in range.
Gold outlines show which storage Quick Stack, Dump, and Craft Nearby can currently use.
quickstackcraft.tutorial.whitelist_black: Bind Cycle Storage Block Whitelist / Blacklist in Options > Controls > QuickStack & Craft.
Aim at storage and press the hotkey once to whitelist every storage block of that type.
Press it again to blacklist every storage block of that type.
Press it a third time to remove that block type from both lists and use normal detection.

quickstackcraft.tutorial.controls.title: Controls
quickstackcraft.tutorial.timeline.help: Click or drag to pause at a step. When focused, use Left / Right to move five seconds, or Home / End.
quickstackcraft.tutorial.hovered_stack.c: Bind Quick Stack Hovered Stack in Options > Controls > Key Binds. It starts unbound.
Point at a stack in your inventory and press that key. Put down any item carried on your cursor first.
Only that stack moves into nearby storage with matching items and room. Other matching stacks stay with you.
The shortcut also works on your hotbar and inside storage screens. Native locks and ItemLocks remain protected.
quickstackcraft.tutorial.button_settings: Open Settings > Buttons. Inventory controls and open-storage controls have separate settings.
Set horizontal and vertical offsets in GUI pixels. Negative numbers move left or up. Buttons follow the inventory.
Hide either toolbar when you prefer keybinds. Bind Open QuickStack & Craft Settings before hiding its button.
Reset Position restores placement. Close Settings to save. These preferences apply only to your client.
